purpose: Machine-readable economic compatibility and policy-based asset selection for autonomous AI agents

meaning.protocol: A successful assessment means an economic action satisfies the agent's authorized policy; it is not an investment or credit rating.

methodology.result: 200 when policy conditions pass; otherwise return a structured non-pass result

declaredEconomicProperties.transferTaxPercentEvidence: behaviorally tested for one standard 1000-token wallet-to-wallet transfer; exact amount received
declaredEconomicProperties.maxTransactionEvidence: behaviorally tested with one 5,000,000-token transfer (5% of total supply); transfer completed
declaredEconomicProperties.maxWalletEvidence: recipient successfully held 5,001,000 200 after test (5.001% of total supply)
declaredEconomicProperties.buyTaxPercentEvidence: behaviorally tested on one PancakeSwap V2 Base Sepolia ETH→200 buy; actual 200 received matched router quote exactly
declaredEconomicProperties.sellTaxPercentEvidence: behaviorally tested on one PancakeSwap V2 Base Sepolia 200→ETH sell; exact 500 200 left wallet and standard router swap confirmed

verification.principle: Declarations should be independently verified before economic action

evidence.scopeNote: Direct checks prove only returned on-chain facts. Contract behaviors such as taxes or blacklist logic require verified source/ABI or behavioral testing.

evidence.observedResult: A standard transfer of 1,000 200 resulted in exactly 1,000 200 at the recipient account.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: This test is behavioral evidence that this ordinary transfer incurred no token-amount deduction. It does not by itself prove every possible transfer path or DEX trade is tax-free.

evidence.observedResult: A single transfer of 5,000,000 200 completed and the recipient balance increased from 1,000 to 5,001,000 200.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: Behavioral evidence that no low max-transaction or low max-wallet restriction interfered with this 5%-of-supply wallet-to-wallet transfer. It does not prove the absence of every possible limit in every context.

evidence.observedResult: Initial 200/ETH liquidity was successfully added to the configured PancakeSwap V2 Base Sepolia pool.
evidence.scopeNote: This confirms liquidity provisioning and LP token minting for the tested deposit. It does not yet establish buy/sell behavior or trade-tax behavior.

evidence.observedResult: BaseScan confirms 0.000001 ETH moved from Account 3 into the PancakeSwap V2 router/pool path and 987.648209114086982351 200 was transferred from the pool to Account 3; the token amount received matched the live router quote exactly.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: On-chain behavioral evidence that the tested ETH→200 PancakeSwap V2 buy executed successfully and delivered the router-quoted 200 amount.

evidence.observedResult: BaseScan confirms 500 200 transferred from Account 3 to the 200/WETH pool and 0.000000506212363177 ETH returned to Account 3; the ETH received matched the router quote exactly.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: On-chain behavioral evidence that the tested 200→ETH PancakeSwap V2 sell executed successfully, debited exactly 500 200, and returned the quoted ETH amount.

evidence.observedResult: BaseScan confirms 100,000 200 and 0.0001 ETH were supplied to the PancakeSwap V2 Base Sepolia pool, and 3.162277660168378331 Cake-LP tokens were minted to Account 2.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: On-chain evidence that the configured 200/WETH PancakeSwap V2 liquidity pool was successfully initialized and funded.

evidence.observedResult: ERC-2612 EIP-712 domain separator matched the computed domain; Account 3 signed a permit for exactly 123 200 to Account 2; the permit was submitted on-chain and allowance(owner, spender) read back exactly 123 200.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: Behavioral evidence that the deployed 200 Token supports ERC-2612 permit signing and on-chain allowance authorization for the tested owner/spender pair.

evidence.observedResult: Account 2 successfully called transferFrom for exactly 10 200 from Account 3 using the ERC-2612-created allowance. The allowance decreased exactly from 123 200 to 113 200.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: Behavioral evidence that the tested ERC-2612-created allowance can be consumed through standard ERC-20 transferFrom semantics.

evidence.observedResult: Account 2, verified as on-chain owner, sent exactly 5 200 to the 200 Token contract. The owner-restricted recovery transaction was confirmed. A fresh on-chain read after confirmation showed the contract balance returned from 5 200 to 0 and Account 2 returned from 94,899,005 200 to its pre-test 94,899,010 200.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: Behavioral evidence that the deployed token recovery function can return the token's own accidentally-held 200 balance to the on-chain owner in the tested scenario.
evidence.note: The immediate post-transaction UI initially displayed stale pre-refresh balances; a fresh RPC read confirmed the final recovered state.

evidence.name: 200 Token
evidence.observedResult: Read-only on-chain review confirmed Account 2 as owner, zero-address pending owner, expected token identity, 18 decimals, total supply of 100,000,000 200, and zero contract-held 200.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: Current Base Sepolia administrative ownership and core token identity match the expected deployment state; no ownership transfer is pending.

evidence.observedResult: Exactly 0.1 LP was approved and removed through PancakeSwap V2. Account 2 received 3146.85686979135337764 200, the minimum-output guard was satisfied, 3.062277660168378331 LP remained, and the pool retained nonzero 200/WETH reserves.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: Behavioral evidence that the Base Sepolia 200/WETH LP position can be partially withdrawn through the configured PancakeSwap V2 router while leaving the pool active.

coreTestnetValidation.caveat: Base Sepolia evidence is scoped testnet evidence and does not by itself guarantee Base mainnet behavior.

humanAuthority.principle: Agents operate within owner-defined economic limits
